abilities.name: synchronize
abilities.effect: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.

abilities.name: trace
abilities.effect: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.

abilities.name: telepathy
abilities.effect: Protects against friendly Pokémon's damaging moves.

hoenn.flavorText: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its TRAINER.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

updated-johto.flavorText: It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power when protecting a Trainer it has bonded closely with.

original-unova.flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

updated-unova.flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

kalos.flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Gardevoir has the psychokinetic power to distort the dimensions and create a small black hole. This Pokémon will try to protect its Trainer even at the risk of its own life.

swsh.flavorText: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

pla.flavorText: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.
